blocks.text: MANILA – The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) on Tuesday warned syndicates exploiting children and Indigenous Peoples through organized street solicitation and caroling activities, which tend to increase during the holiday season. “Hindi po natin hahayaan na maabuso ng mga mapagsamantala ang mga kabataan at bulnerableng pamilya ngayong Kapaskuhan. Patuloy po tayong kikilos upang matiyak ang kanilang kaligtasan at maprotektahan sila laban sa anumang uri ng pagsasamantala (We will not allow unscrupulous individuals to abuse the youth and vulnerable families this Christmas season.
